info.title: Beskar API
info.description:
Authentication and implemented whiteboarding v2 APIs.

**Try it:** [Sign in](/auth/login?returnTo=%2Fapi%2Fdocs), then use the browser-session option, or select BearerToken and paste a valid Zitadel JWT (without the Bearer prefix). The server currently verifies bearer JWTs using its OIDC ID-token verifier; opaque access tokens are not supported. Calls run against this origin with your permissions and can create real data.

Replace example space/parent IDs with your own. Generate an Idempotency-Key UUID for each new board or checkpoint batch and keep it with the same payload for retries. Login, registration and logout require browser navigation. Cookie sessions normally require HTTPS.

post.description: Creates a board in the v2 schema. Requires space edit_page permission and parent edit permission when nested. Generate a fresh UUID Idempotency-Key per create action; reuse it and the same body on retries. Replays return 201 with the original IDs. Unknown fields, invalid UTF-8 and trailing JSON are rejected. Maximum body: 16 KiB. V2 incremental checkpoints are supported. V2 retrieval and publication are not implemented yet; v1 readers cannot load this board.

post.description:
Requires page edit permission and matching page/space membership. Appends one Yjs v1 batch and advances the existing draft atomically; the base snapshot remains unchanged. The draft row lock serializes sequence allocation. No expected-head or base-snapshot parameter is required.

Generate a UUID Idempotency-Key for each batch and retain it with the exact pending bytes until acknowledged. Matching retries return the original acknowledgement even if the head has advanced or the space was subsequently archived/soft-deleted, provided authorization and board membership still hold. Different actors may submit overlapping changes; Yjs handles their document effect. Acknowledgement confirms storage, not reception of other actors’ edits.

Maximum decoded update: 1 MiB (1048576 bytes). Maximum JSON body: 1.5 MiB (1572864 bytes). Client batching target: 256 KiB or two seconds of pending edits; that queue is not implemented by this endpoint. Images upload separately. Optional title metadata is saved atomically at this sequence. No snapshot compaction or permission provisioning occurs here. Unknown fields, extra JSON values and malformed Yjs v1 wire structures are rejected. Structural validation does not verify drawing schema or causal completeness. Deploy the whiteboard_updates and whiteboard_titles Liquibase changesets before using this operation. Title is authoritative checkpoint metadata; a title-only rename uses the empty Yjs update AAA=. Omitted title preserves the current value. Same key with another normalized title returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

get.description: Requires page edit permission. Creates a one-hour actor-scoped replay lease pinning an immutable base snapshot and captured head. Archived spaces remain readable; deleted spaces do not. No body, query parameters or idempotency key. Sequence fields are decimal strings. Follow downloadUrl and updatesUrl with the same authenticated identity. New saves do not enter this replay. Repeating the manifest request creates another lease and can capture a newer head. Deploy whiteboard_draft_replay.xml first. Top-level title is captured at headSequence; baseSnapshot.title remains the base title. Deploy whiteboard_titles.xml.

get.summary: Get a bounded draft update page
get.description: Use the opaque cursor from the manifest or previous nextCursor. Up to 64 whole updates and 4 MiB decoded bytes per page; Base64/JSON adds overhead. Sequences are contiguous and bounded by the original captured head. Follow nextCursor until complete=true and nextCursor=null. Retrying a cursor is stable while the lease is valid. A gap fails closed and may be detected on a subsequent page. Authentication and edit permission are checked on every request.

get.summary: Download a draft snapshot as binary
get.description: Raw Yjs v1 snapshot bytes. The actor-scoped replay must be unexpired and identify this snapshot. Supports resumable single-range downloads and conditional requests. PostgreSQL bytes are fetched in chunks of at most 256 KiB; an MVCC transaction remains open for the transfer. Expiry during an in-flight transfer does not truncate it; later requests require a valid lease. Storage failures after headers abort the transport; verify byte length and SHA-256 before applying the assembled snapshot. Future object storage can replace this reader behind the same application URL.

post.summary: Publish a whiteboard at a durable sequence
post.description: Requires edit permission. Reconstructs Yjs state through sequence and atomically creates its snapshot, version, and current publication pointer. Retries return the original version without moving the pointer. Keys are scoped to board and actor. Archived spaces reject new publications. Replay is bounded to 32 MiB and 10,000 updates. Requires whiteboard_publication.xml and the pinned Node/Yjs runtime. Title edits use optional checkpoint title metadata; the requested sequence determines the published title. Deploy whiteboard_titles.xml. External raster references are extracted from the reconstructed state, checked against this board's committed asset catalog, and retained in the immutable snapshot manifest. Invalid or uncommitted references reject publication. Deploy whiteboard_assets_v2.xml. Requires a client-generated PNG in preview.contentType/data. PNG is validated and stored atomically with publication; retries must keep the same sequence and image. 6 MiB JSON body limit. Deploy whiteboard_previews.xml. The server does not verify visual correspondence to the Yjs snapshot.

post.summary: Restore a published version to draft
post.description: Requires edit permission and an active space. Replaces the draft at expectedHeadSequence+1, increments restoreGeneration, and preserves the current publication. Concurrent changes return DRAFT_HEAD_CHANGED. Retry identical body/version/key for the original result. Old-generation checkpoints are rejected, including old checkpoint retries. Reinspects the source snapshot digest and validates committed same-board raster dependencies, then copies their associations and completed manifest atomically with the restored snapshot.

delete.description: Requires delete permission and an active space. Rejects boards with child pages. Atomically removes board content and core page; retains creation receipt identity to prevent resurrection by old retries. Missing boards return 204 after authorization. Does not recursively delete children. Records durable asset object cleanup jobs and releases board storage accounting before deleting catalog/upload rows; these jobs survive the board and never release quota twice.

get.summary: Read the latest v1 state for migration
get.description: Requires page edit permission and current space membership. Read-only: selects the current legacy draft, otherwise the latest publication, and returns its state, title, source document ID, and server-computed fingerprint. Supports canonical Glideboard raster assets and validated self-contained SVG assets. Unknown formats and invalid or unresolved references fail closed. Already migrated pages return contentApiVersion 2 and sourceDocId 0. No v2 board is created. Requires the migration and asset changesets and the Node/Yjs runtime.

post.summary: Migrate the latest legacy board and publish it
post.description: Requires page edit permission and current space membership. Publishes the selected latest legacy state as version 1 while preserving page identity, permissions, and legacy history. Independently inspects source and submitted states and requires identical raster descriptors and all asset identities. Copies fully verified original files from the same-page v1 catalog into independent v2 storage keys; validated SVG assets stay inline. Durable cleanup intents cover interrupted copies. Rechecks source and catalog under locks, then atomically commits asset ownership, quota usage, snapshot asset associations, draft, version, PNG, publication pointer, and receipt at sequence 0. Legacy files remain retained and the additional copies consume storage quota. Legacy writes are rejected after cutover. Completed retries reuse the receipt without copying or charging again. Same actor/key with changed request bytes returns 409. Source conflicts require fresh preparation and a new key. JSON body limit 49 MiB, decoded snapshot 32 MiB, PNG 4 MiB; raster limits match v2 asset uploads. Archived spaces reject new migration; completed receipts remain replayable. The client verifies snapshot/preview correspondence.

GET supports one byte range, If-Range and If-None-Match; HEAD ignores Range and describes the complete representation. Missing stored content is a 503 storage error, never an empty replacement image.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Existing v2 whiteboard page ID in the supplied space.

parameters.name: contentHash
parameters.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hash of the original image bytes.

200.description: Verified image metadata headers; no response body.

409.description: ASSET_NOT_READY, ASSET_UPLOAD_CONFLICT, SPACE_ARCHIVED, ASSET_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, or IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED

500.description: ASSET_OPERATION_FAILED; inspect session status before retrying

get.description: Requires current view permission, matching board/space/version, membership in that immutable snapshot asset manifest, and a completed manifest bound to the snapshot digest. Archived boards remain readable. Authenticated on every request; no query parameters. Uses verified MIME, digest ETag, Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. GET supports one byte range, If-Range and If-None-Match; HEAD ignores Range and describes the complete representation. Missing stored content is a 503 storage error, never an empty replacement image.

BearerToken.description: Valid Zitadel JWT accepted by the server OIDC verifier. Paste only the token.

BrowserSession.name: zitadel.session
BrowserSession.description: Sign in using the link above. The browser sends the HttpOnly session cookie automatically; do not paste a cookie value.

title.description: Trimmed before validation; 1–255 Unicode characters after trimming. NUL characters are rejected.

parentId.description: Parent page in this space. Omit or use null for a top-level board.

updateEncoding.description: Yjs binary update format; maps to update_encoding. Independent of the API version.

update.description: Standard Base64 encoding of a structurally valid Yjs v1 update. Decoded bytes must be nonempty and at most 1048576 bytes. The entire JSON body must fit within 1572864 bytes. Do not split binary updates at arbitrary byte offsets.

title.description: Optional rename at this checkpoint sequence. Trimmed; null/blank/NUL rejected. Use update AAA= for a title-only rename. Omit to preserve title.

restoreGeneration.description: Draft restore generation from the manifest. Omission means 0; stale generations receive 409 WHITEBOARD_RESTORED.

updateId.description: Server-generated batch identity; stable across matching retries.

sequence.description: This batch’s committed position, from 1 to 9223372036854775807. Decimal string preserves BIGINT precision. Replays return the original position, not the current draft head.

throughSequence.description: Nonnegative BIGINT sequence as a decimal string.

headSequence.description: Nonnegative BIGINT sequence as a decimal string.

title.description: Title at the captured head sequence.

sequence.description: Nonnegative BIGINT sequence as a decimal string.

update.description: One whole Yjs v1 update, at most 1 MiB decoded.

title.description: Present only when this checkpoint renames the board.

headSequence.description: Nonnegative BIGINT sequence as a decimal string.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation. Null on the final page.

data.description: PNG bytes without data URL prefix; max 4 MiB, 4096 pixels per dimension, 8 million pixels total.

WhiteboardNavigation.description: Content API URLs, present only for v2 whiteboards. Draft requires edit access; published URLs require a published version. Preview is omitted when unavailable.

contentApiVersion.description: 1 for legacy content, 2 for v2 whiteboards.

sourceDocId.description: Positive int64 encoded as a decimal string.

state.description: Complete Yjs update-v1 state, at most 32 MiB decoded, preserving the selected source assets. boardIdentity must be v2:{spaceId}:{pageId}. Raster bytes are copied server-side from the legacy catalog; do not embed them in this request.

downloadUrl.description: Same-origin editor download route. Build version-specific resolver URLs for published readers; persist the asset ID rather than download URLs in canvas state.

retained.description: Commit won; the committed asset is retained.

cleanupPending.description: Recorded cancellation still has asynchronous cleanup work.
